title: Developer Experiences with Cursor AI-native IDE
abstract: arXiv:2610.20618v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-powered integrated development environments (IDEs) are increasingly positioned as practical tools for software development, integrating AI assistance into everyday activities such as editing, refactoring, and debugging. However, how developers evaluate AI IDEs as working environments, what frictions shape their adoption, and which aspects of the experience matter most in everyday use remain underexplored. Prior evidence on adoption and use is mainly controlled tasks, small interview samples, and short observation windows, which offer limited visibility into longitudinal, community-driven experience and the workflow drift that emerges in everyday practice. To bridge this gap, we conduct a large-scale longitudinal study of Cursor, a prominent AI-native IDE, through its official public forum, where users report bugs, request features, and discuss everyday use. translated_title: 开发者使用Cursor AI原生集成开发环境的体验
translated_abstract: AI驱动的集成开发环境（IDE）日益被视为软件开发的实用工具，将AI辅助融入编辑、重构和调试等日常活动中。然而，开发者如何评估AI IDE作为工作环境、哪些摩擦因素影响了他们的采用、以及在日常使用中哪些体验方面最为重要，这些问题仍未得到充分探索。此前关于采用和使用的证据主要来自受控任务、小型访谈样本和短时间观察窗口，这些方法对于纵向的、社区驱动的体验以及日常实践中出现的工作流漂移所提供的可见性有限。为了弥合这一差距，我们通过Cursor的官方公共论坛对其开展了大规模纵向研究。Cursor是一款知名的AI原生IDE，用户在该论坛上报告错误、请求功能并讨论日常使用。我们的分析涵盖了两年多时间里收集的14,714条论坛帖子。
tldr: 本研究通过分析Cursor官方论坛两年多来的14,714条帖子，大规模纵向考察了开发者使用AI原生IDE的真实体验、采用摩擦及工作流演变。
en_tdlr: This study conducts a large-scale longitudinal analysis of 14,714 forum posts from over two years to investigate developers' real-world experiences, adoption frictions, and workflow drift with the Cursor AI-native IDE.
